title: Insights Changed Webhook
description: Account-anchored invalidation fired when the semantic insight snapshot or its evaluation coverage changes on a media buy, package, or package–creative assignment. Registered prospectively through sync_accounts notification_configs with event_types: ["insights.changed"]; activation does not replay current insights, so buyers establish a complete get_media_buys baseline by enumerating known IDs or requesting every media-buy status and exhausting pagination, without an insight filter. The payload is not authoritative insight state: receivers verify signing, dedupe by idempotency_key, then use get_media_buys without an insight filter. Re-evaluation that changes only insights_as_of MUST NOT fire; a material in-place creative update invalidates prior assignment evaluations and MUST fire.

idempotency_key.description: Random fire identifier reused across retries. Receivers dedupe within the authenticated sender scope.

notification_id.description: Stable identity for this logical snapshot change across re-emissions. A later semantic change receives a new value.

change_kind.description: Coarse invalidation reason. Buyers MUST reread rather than applying this value as state. invalidated is emitted when a material creative-content update retires the prior evaluation and the relationship becomes unknown until reevaluated. assignment_removed is emitted to insight subscribers when deletion retires keys for a package–creative relationship.

changed_insight_types.description: Types known to be affected. This is a reread hint, not a complete current set.

observed_at.description: When the seller observed the semantic snapshot change.

examples.description: Creative fatigue changed for one assignment
